balls.text: that looked effortless! Slower ball from Mahdwal, but he ended up bowling a little wide of off, and more importantly, on a length. Surya went low in the crease, and reached out to deposit the ball over long-on
another yorker from Madhwal. He's keeping it tight here. This comes on to middle and leg, and is squeezed back to long-on

lovely execution from Madhwal... but it's still four. It was an inswinging yorker which arrived on leg, and Pandya whipped at it with all his might. The ball dribbled towards the square-leg boundary, and Pandya started running with his bat dropped off his hands
another yorker, and at just 115kph. This is just outside off, and Surya drives to deep cover
nicely bowled. He teases Surya with a slower ball, which arrives also as a yorker on sixth stump. Surya thinks about having a go at it, but lets it go eventually
starts with a lowish full toss on off, and Pandya drives aerially towards long-off
this is very full, and straight. Whipped to deep midwicket by Pandya

on the bounce to deep third, who didn't go for the catch. It was Kartikeya there, and Archer isn't happy. Archer bowled it short and at a change of pace outside off. Surya ended up playing a mix of a swat and slash to deep third
a yorker-length ball just outside off, as Surya looks to loft through the line but misses. A rare dot ball, you'd think, although it happened only three deliveries back
on a full length, and just outside off. Sliced aerially to deep cover

Surya hasn't played a great shot if he hasn't fallen on his back. He predicts it's going to be an attempted yorker around middle and off, and he gets across to scoop this over short fine leg with the ball coming on as a low full toss
a yorker floated on he stumps, and seemingly, at a change of pace. Surya can only jam his bat down on it for a dot
hacked to deep-backward point. Farooqi bowls this short and wide outside off, and Pandya this time gets the room from the bowler to free his arms for another boundary

wow, how did that reach the boundary?! Pandya rolls his wrists almost last moment at this short ball outside leg, even as it was a slower ball. He finished well outside off to get full room for the pull, and get four to fine leg
good work by the man at long-on, as he dives to his right to keep this to two. Another fullish ball, this one on the stumps, as Pandya helicoptered this away in Dhoni style

bam! Six down the ground. This is a length delivery angling in, and pitching around fifth stump. His front leg is out of the way, and he powers it back with the full face of the bat with some bottom hand

lovely slice wide of long-off! Farooqi went for the yorker, but while angling in, the ball ended up as a low full toss just outside off. Pandya opened the face of the bat and went low to loft it gently
he looks to paddle sweep this short-of-a-length ball on middle and off, but is hit on his pad outside off. The ball dribbles away to the off side for a leg bye
excellent yorker on middle, and Surya can only squeeze it to point
swatted over short fine leg! Slower ball, but short on middle. Surya reads the change of pace, and rides the bounce, before sending it for six after getting across

just short of deep third, but that isn't the story of this ball. It is, instead, how Surya hit it. The ball is short, and on off. And Surya, almost getting cramped, opens the face of the bat to slice it as awkwardly as possible
very full, and just about on off. Pandya drills it to long-off
an inswinging yorker which arrives on leg, as Pandya gets his front leg out of the way, and jams his bat down for two to deep-backward square leg
Jaiswal nearly overran to his left from long-off, and took the ball on the bounce. It was bowled on a length, and outside off, as Pandya opened the face of the bat to loft

swept over short fine leg! The key there was how straight back the ball went, as Surya got across and took a big stride forward early. The ball came as yet another full toss - this time on the stumps, and slightly higher - and that was the perfect delivery to send swinging
drilled to deep extra cover, as Pandya goes low to slam this low full toss around sixth stump
fullish ball, but again very wide of off. Pandya lets it go
it is a low full toss again, as the ball drifts in towards middle. Driven down to long-off by Surya
this is a wide yorker outside off, and Surya can only slice it towards point
another attempted yorker, but this ends as a low full toss on middle. Swiped to deep midwicket for a single
full and wide of off, and left alone

ohh, Theekshana's groan was so audible there! In fact, he's down on his back now. And, by the way, the ball went for four down the ground. Theekshana bowled a yorker-length ball on the stumps, and Pandya hammered it back to tickle Theekshana's fingers on his right hand. The ball still went racing away for four, though

good execution of the yorker. He lands it band on off, as Pandya opens the face of the bat to squeeze it to point. Surya was running towards the danger end, and the throw from point seemed to have hit him
paddle sweeps this full and wide-ish ball outside off to fine leg
just short of Parag running forward from long-on! The ball seemed to have stopped on the pitch before coming on a length around off to Pandya, who ended up chipping down the ground
goes for the yorker, and gets the ball to swing back in for a low full toss on middle. That is driven down the wicket, and they run two by the time long-on moves to his left to cut it off
another full toss, but this is slightly wide of off. It arrives below Surya's waist, and he slashes it to deep third
a high full toss around sixth stump, and it is slapped to deep cover. But the ball isn't high enough to be called a no-ball

lovely placement. There was a deep third this time, but he was beaten to his right despite diving full stretch. Farooqi bowled on a short of a length, and in the corridor outside off. Suryakumar played the late cut for four more

typical Suryakumar! A one-handed upper cut for four. A bouncer pitching on middle and leg, and at a change of pace. The ball shaped away to finish around sixth stump, and also got big after bouncing. But Surya rode the bounce, and dispatched that over short third
misfield by Theekshana tumbling to his right at short third, and that's a single. Farooqi bowled a yorker around off, as Pandya jammed his bat down
slapped wide of extra cover. He waits for this slower ball on a short of a length to arrive pretty wide of off, and finds the gap to the ight of the man at deep cover
short in length, and almost cramping Suryakumar from room by arriving on middle. But despite the presence of a short third, he manages to ramp towards deep third
just beats the man at short third to his right. It was a slower ball on a short of a length, and slightly wide of off. Suryakumar went slashing at it away from his body for a single to deep third
much fuller and slower, and wide of off. Left alone by Pandya
on the bounce to short third. He shifts his weight back to slash this shortish ball just outside off, and gets it off the top edge

taken at long-off! This time Parag was back bowling with the usual bowling action, and he gets Rohit. Parag tossed it up nicely, and angled it across to bowl full and a little wide of off. Rohit went lofting seeing the flight and the dip, but ended up finding Jaiswal, who moved to his right to grab the ball
fullish length on leg, and it hits Rohit's pad as he looks to whip
another roundarm, Kedar Jadhav-like action. Full outside off, and driven to deep cover
oohh, complete slip there! Parag went with a roundarm action, but ended up floating this full and wide of off. Left alone by Suryakumar
full and angling across to arrive outside off. Swept to deep-backward square leg
swept away first ball! He goes across and also low, and fetches this full ball from around fifth stump to paddle sweep wide of the man at short fine leg

gone! Bowled him! Theekshana breaks the century stand. Rickelton looks to swing across the line, but is beaten. The ball was angled across, before it landed on a short of a length on middle and leg. It jussssst shaped to straighten after pitching, and that tiny bit was enough for the ball to strike leg stump after Rickelton missed his attempted slog
slapped back straight down the pitch, as Theekshana bowls on a length, and just outside off
very full and angling across, and just outside off. Rickelton drives to long-off from the bottom of the bat
again Rickelton makes room, and the bowler responds. Theekshana bowls this full and wide of off, and it is called wide after Rickelton lets it go
slower from Theekshana, who bowls this on a short of a length on off. Rohit reverse sweeps this to short third
sliced over point! The ball is a yorker-length one, and wide of off. He throws his bat at it, and times it nicely to go over the fielder, and raise another fifty
bang! Rickelton makes up for the miss on the last ball. Parag went full and slower, and just outside off, as Rickelton got his front leg out of the way to launch it over Parag's head
Parag spots Rickelton backing away, and floated this full and wide-ish of off. Rickelton ended up reaching out and driving to extra cover
full and outside off, and angling across to arrive around sixth stump. Driven hard to deep point
this is a low full toss around his shin, as Rohit leans forward and pushes to long-on. And in no time, they push for and get two
fuller, flatter and quicker, as he goes around fifth stump. That is thumped to long-on by Rickelton
short of a length on the stumps, and clipped to deep midwicket
Clipped off the pads through square leg

Rohit anticipates the length and goes inside outside cover. Madhwal went for the yorker again but landed it a bit too short, but the line was the bigger issue. Around fifth stump, enough room for Rohit to pump it through the line
One more nailed yorker. 137ks on middle, lands around the crease. Rohit's front foot was out the way, the back foot had to bob a touch too for the bat to jam down
Yorker is jammed to mid-off for a quick single

Another yorker. Driven to cover from middle stump. Slight stoppage in the running, the fielder - Suryavanshi - doesn't pick it up properly on the first attempt. He throws it hard later but the bowler can't stop it and there was no one close backing up
Nails the line, too, on this yorker. On middle, all Rickelton could do was jam it towards midwicket
Past the flick, wide given. Madhwal wonders if that brushed the pads, Jurel isn't sure. No review. 140ks ball was full and landed just outside the crease, Rickelton tried to whip it fine
Wide on a length, reaches out and underedges a cut to cover

Short ball sits up, Rickelton muscles a pull over midwicket to raise a 29-ball fifty. Lots of applause from the dugout as the crowd goes quiet. He raises his bat high. That ball landed well down leg and didn't bounce much, hit from top-of-pad height, but he had ample time to play it. 96-metre hit
Beaten on the slog sweep. Length ball on fifth stump skidded through, didn't spin, went below bat. Bowler asks if there was an under-edge, keeper says no
Low fully on off is driven to long-off
Paddled fine. Helped it off a shortish length, from in front of middle. Didn't bounce much. Was a quicker ball
Sweps the lowish full toss through square leg, Madhwal runs left and slides. Can't get to it.
Full on the pads. Rickelton tries to whip it square and gets beaten
Length on leg, goes for the flick. Doesn't get it. Ball trickles nearby. 138ks
Rickelton gets cramped for room but twirls and pulls wide to the right of short fine leg. Back of length ball followed him after he made room, slightly under waist-high
Top-edged pull goes over the keeper. Was actually a good bouncer, 135ks, angling away over fourth stump. Around shoulder-height, hurried the pull.
Length on off, 132ks, flicked off the back foot to deep square leg
Touch back of length on fifth, cut hard and along the ground to deep-backward square
99ks shin-high full toss is wide. Slapped to deep cover
Works it off the back foot to the leg side

Cut late, it's in the gap to the left of backward point. Thought it was going towards the fielder at first but the uppish ball was in the gap. 84ks googly was slightly short and wide, cut very late and against the spin
Wide and fullish, slapped hard. Finds cover. 100ks
Full and slow on fourth, paddle swept towards fine leg
Length around off, punched to the bowler's left with a straight bat
Full on leg, beats the flick and pops off the pad to the bowler's left

Theekshana is almost celebrappealing, he's signalling for the review. Parag runs in from long-on... and they don't review. Replay shows it landed just outside leg. Good call in the end. Was a shortish ball that beat the back-foot flick and hit Rickelton on the back leg
Sits up and it's slapped through cover. Shortish ball well outside off, spongy bounce
Low fully on off, driven to cover who stops it well
Rohit doesn't have to move this time. Overpitched ball's on fourth stump and Rohit step-hits it over mid-off again
Makes room and pumps it over mid-off. Theekshana tried following him and bowled full, Rohit was right behind it though and drove hard. Was a carrom ball
Uses the pace and pulls it handsomely. In front of square too. Off a length, at the stumps, zipped off the pitch too; Rickelton stood still and swung right on time
Overpitched, pumped over mid-on. High-back-lift helps Rickelton generate power despite closing the bat face late
Aerial... but deep-backward square can't get to it again... Takes it on the bounce, Archer smiles. Was a slightly back--of-length ball at the hips that was pulled
Full on leg, clipped to deep midwicket

Rohit plays the field. Makes room and opens up the off side, no deep fielders there of course. Was a shortish ball over leg stump, 147ks, Rohit turned it into a short-and-wide ball and cut it behind point. Raced along the ground
Pick-up flick to the full ball on middle and leg goes over square leg. Deep-backward square runs right and stops it on the bounce
Back of length on fifth, angle away, Rohit stands tall and punches to cover
Slow length ball around off, flicked softly towards midwicket
Low fully around off, punched to mid-off

Rickelton waits for the ball to arrive close to him, pulls it wide to the right of short fine leg. Was a length ball that was around top-of-pad height, Rickelton jumped a bit, probably didn't get enough bounce to work with, but the bat-swing was low

Slower one's been clipped, very wristy, clears the deep-midwicket boundary! Didn't look like there was much power on that, timing was exquisite. Was a fullish length ball around middle, played from well in front of the body
Pitched up on middle, punched back to the bowler
Opens the face late to turn a lofted straight drive into a lofted square drive. The ball was full and floaty for a change, line was around fourth and Rohit cleared point with ease
Shortish on off, worked off the back foot through mid-on
Full ball lands outside leg and beats the slog sweep. 107ks. Small stride from Rickelton, he wanted to go over square leg
Makes room and gets followed by the shortish ball, beaten on the sweep. Hit on the pad
Quick single towards cover. Looked like a medium pacer's delivery. Fuller side of length around off, 102ks
Good stop by Parag at mid-off, moved right and got his body behind the travelling ball. Was a 103ks length ball to which Rickelton went back and drove
Yorker around off, jammed towards point

LBW appeal... given right away. That looked out. Rohit has a chat with Rickelton and reviews.  Pitching outside leg is the only way he can get away with it. And it is...! Just over half the ball pitching outside leg and Rohit goes 'yeah!' and smiles. Was a three-quarter length ball that skidded through and would've hit middle. Rohit was early into the full-fledged flick, the arc of the bat swing was straight, like with a drive, but the bat face was slightly closed. Hit on the back thigh, leg was bent. So, height wouldn't have been an issue
Helped along from waist-height. Back-of-length ball around off, Rohit standing still and using his torso to wind across and pull behind square
Good ball. Fullish on fourth, zips off the pitch and goes through the channel. Let go. Keeper takes it high
Overpitched at the stumps, flicked hard and flat behind square. Suryavanshi runs and slides across to keep it to two
Low fully on off, gets low and punches to mid-off
Wide and full, kept going away. Well past the off-stump tramline, let go.
Length just outside off, let go. Good carry to the keeper

Seam in off a back of length, well negotiated by Rohit. He was probably shaping up for an off-side shot but had to jump and adjust due to lack of room. The bat turned vertical and went close to the chest, ball hit high on the sticker and dribbled towards point
Pushed through fuller. Middle-stump line, 146.7ks, Rohit lunges across with still feet and flicks it softly to square leg
Spears in off a length, flicked to forward square leg. 146ks, looked pacy, might've come off the pitch a touch. Was a skiddy ball, rose around top of the stumps
Length on fourth, dabbed towards point off the back foot

Sharp movement away to beat bat. Upright seam but that moved away in the air, hit a hard length around off and kept going away, Rickelton was tentative and had a small push at it but the bat didn't go too far away from the body. Smiles exchanged between him and Archer

lovely catch by Bumrah! MI win by exactly a hundred runs. Placed at short fine leg, Bumrah stretched both his hands out to his left, and the ball did end up sticking there. Boult bowled a short delivery on leg at Archer, who looked like backing away in an attempt to pull it. But the ball came off the top half of the bat, and only chipped up to finish within the 30-yard circle
this is the googly, as it pitches on a short of a length on middle, and finishes on leg. Clipped towards deep midwicket
full and slow, and a little wide of off. Driven hard to long-off
short in length, and wide of off. Archer slaps it to deep cover
full and slow on off, and flung to long-on
full, and quicker, on off. Blocked down
loopy, full and very slow, as he bowls wide of off. The ball turns away as Madhwal looks to swing across the line, and misses
Bumrah fires another bouncer, and pitches this around fifth stump. Archer ducks again
short ball again outside off. This, though, finishes on middle, and takes the leading edge towards point as Archer looks to clip
short in length on middle and off, and nudged towards midwicket
bouncer again, as this pitches outside off, and finishes on middle. Archer ducks to let it go
bouncer from Bumrah on off, as Madhwal half-ducks, and takes his eyes off. He eventually ends up fending it to the leg side off his glove
the ball swings in, and comes on as a full toss below his knee on middle. Whipped to fine leg by going back in the crease
full again, and on off. Tapped to point to keep MI waiting
full and slow, and on off. Driven to long-off
pulled to deep square leg! Short in length on middle and leg, and Archer shifted his weight back to dispatch that

dropped by Tilak, but it was a difficult chance! Karn bowled it full and around sixth stump, as Madhwal lofted down hard and flat. Tilak, at long-off, moved to his right and went low, but the ball didn't stick in his hands as he tumbled
well short of deep midwicket running forward. Archer went slog sweeping at this full and slow delivery outside off, but mistimed it
fullish, and wide of off. He drives away from his body to long-off
fuller ball, and just outside off. Driven to deep cover by opening the face of the bat
fuller side of a length, and outside off. Driven to extra cover for a quick single
change of pace this time. He bowls on a length, and around sixth stump. Archer looks to swipe, but is beaten
swatted wide of long-on! Another short ball from Bosch, who went on off, but Archer, who was deep in the crease and also gave himself room, hooked for six more
pulled forcefully! Short ball outside off, and it keeps low while arriving on middle. But Archer has a swivel, and creams the ball over square leg
on a length on middle and off, and flung away to midwicket

nearly bowled! How could that miss the off stump?! It was the googly on a length around off, and Madhwal looked to defend with a massive gap between bat and pad. He missed, and the ball barely beat the off stump

good catch by Chahar! Kartikeya went slogging, and although he mistimed it well in front of Chahar at long-on, the latter did well to keep his eyes one the ball and move forward a good few steps. Chahar even slid to complete the catch, as Kartikeya slogged at this fullish and straight ball
on a length, and outside leg. Kartikeya goes back, and looks to clip, and gets it off his pads right behind the wicket
full and slow, and on off or thereabouts. Pushed back aerially to wide long-off
beaten! He nearly gets the hat-trick. Full and slow, and around fifth stump. The ball turns away to beat the outside edge, as Kartikeya looked to drive

taken at short cover! Karn bowled it short on middle, and the ball kept low. There was a hint of turn away from Theekshana, who went for the pull, but ended up getting a top edge. The ball went a fair bit up in the air, and Suryakumar called for the catch to avoid confusion with Karn

dropped by Bumrah?! Yup, he did get a hand to it. He bowled it fullish, and outside off, as Theekshana drove back aerially. The ball came back at Bumrah's right, even as his follow through was taking him to his left. The ball trickled away behind the bowler for a single
another yorker attempt from Bumrah. He ends up bowling a low, dipping full toss, as the ball angled into off. Jammed back by Theekshana

ohh, hits his helmet! Another bouncer around off, and Theekshana took his eyes off the ball while ducking. He even turned his face around, and the ball smacked the back of the helmet, before racing away to beat the keeper to his right. The physio is out for the mandatory concussion check
Bumrah follows the bouncer with the yorker. This ball arrives on off, and is pushed to short extra cover
short ball this time. In fact, it is called first bouncer. Bumrah bowled on on off, and got Theekshana ducking. The ball ended up on leg after some sharp movement back in
on the fuller side of a length on off, as the ball is angled in. But is straightens after pitching, and is tucked to point
wow, lovely yorker! The ball swings in, and arrives right on the base of the bat on middle and on. Theekshana nearly slips while squeezing it to long-on
short ball at Theekshana too. Bosch bangs it on off, and has Theekshana ducking, with the ball finishing on middle after seaming in
very full, and on off. Driven all along the ground to long-on
pulled hard to fine leg! He nearly loses his balance in playing that, even as he swivels at another short ball

there is a faint tickle as the ball passes the bat... and both Bosch and Rickelton are up in celebration. It's given out too, but wait, Archer reviews. It is another short ball from Bosch, who bowled this just outside off. There is some extra bounce, and guess what, UltraEdge shows the ball going over the bat bat, and instead tickling the side of the right shoulder
short in length around fifth stump, and seaming in a a bit to arrive just outside off. Dabbed to point by opening the face of the bat

Lobbed back to the bowler. Karn is ecstatic, Jurel shakes his head on the walk back. Touch unlucky for Jurel. Was a 91ks length ball around middle that Jurel tried to short-arm sweep. Got a leading edge onto helmet, ball popped forward. Karn rushed and took a low catch
Very slow, gets turn too. Nope, my bad, it's 96ks. Shortish around middle and off, went a touch low, Archer got inside the line and flicked behind square
Length at the stumps, worked off the back foot to long-on
Makes room and thrashes it inside out over extra cover. Was a legbreak on a length at middle and off, slashed with the spin. 79 metres far
Wide and full, looks to slash square and under-edges it through where leg slip would've been
Fullish around off, 88ks, punched to long-off
Touch back of length on leg, clipped through square leg. 140ks
Change in length. Fullish on middle and off, Archer flicks it from the crease to deep square leg
Back of length from wide of the crease, angling in to go over off. Archer goes back and defends to the bowler
Another bouncer, Hardik not happy that it's called two for the over. Looked like it was around head-height. Archer bowed down again and had the bat low
Bumper. One for the over called. Landed very short and went over the stumps, Archer bowed down to let it go

Taken at long-on, Hardik strikes first ball. Fullish 132ks ball just outside off, Shubham looked to clear long-on with the lofted drive but the bat-face closed a bit too much upon impact. Easy catch to the left for Boult

Appeal for caught behind, not given. A bit of confusion out there. MI have a chat about the review but it looks like Jurel has reviewed for wide. MI prolly won't mind as Ultra-Edge doesn't detect an edge. The short ball was going over the batter's left shoulder. Jurel was on middle and off, third ump says it'd have been in line with the batter if he stood his ground.
Short over middle and off. Sharp angle in. Jurel ducks under it. One for the over called. 137ks. Looks like Bumrah's seeing this is as a pitch aiding pace
Shortish at the body, clipped towards midwicket
Length around fourth, defended towards cover pointx

Run-out chance, no direct hit at the striker's end. Flicked to the right of midwicket, who was standing closeby. Shubman made sure he slid the bat in after getting close to the crease to ensure he wasn't in the way of the throw
Three-quarter length on off, defended towards point
Past the pull. Will MI take the review? No. Shubham tried to repeat the last shot but this shortish ball sped past his right shoulder as he lunged down on one knee.
Picked up over fine leg. Terrific shot considering it was a shortish ball. Looked like the ball was going over middle, not leg. Bat went from down to up, the 140ks did help
Shortish at the body, 140ks. Around rib-height. Shubham's behind the ball and blocks it with the straight bat
Wide on a length, toe-edges a slap to mid-off.
Wide on a back of length, Shubham uses the angle to cut it through cover
Length just down leg, flicked leg side
Slower one, Dubey manages to handle it nicely. Leans across and punches the 118ks full offcutter on fourth straight of mid-off

Bumrah on a hat-trick and Hetmyer can't believe he's found the fielder. He's middled a pull but it's gone straight to SKY at forward square leg/midwicket. He's on one of the pitches, well in front of the ring. 134ks bouncer was around chest-height. Shot was timed well, may have been to get the fielder out of position but SKY took it just above head. Bumrah pumps his fists.

Bouncer's too good! Bumrah got fine deep leg back from deep square and shot in. Neck-high bouncer. Angle in was sharp and the ball zipped off the pitch, hurrying Parag on the pull. He was looking towards fine leg after making contact. Ball popped high off the shoulder of the bat and went to midwicket
Chips it through square leg. Skiddy back-of-length ball at the body, Parag's backlift may have been a touch early but he timed the roll of the wrist nicely
At the body. Tucked through the leg side
Hits high on the splice first up. Short ball at the body, Parag's hopping inside the crease, he's fending but the hands aren't too far in front. Ball pops nearby

The extra ball works in Boult's favour, Rana has picked up a slightly back-of-length ball and picks out deep square leg right on the rope. Tilak was still while taking the catch just over his left shoulder. Maintained his balance nicely. 137ks scrambled-seam ball was coming in at the stumps, shot was on tbf. But RR have lost three in the powerplay
Rana goes back again, he's standing inches in front of off stump as the full ball is speared ever so slightly down leg. Goes past the flick
Goes back to make a length ball shorter than it is. Fifth-stump line, it's enough room for Rana to cut it hard through cover
Length on fourth, worked to midwicket
Fullish on sixth, punched to deep point
Wide and full, free slash for Parag. Bends the back leg and slices it up and over cover
Test ball again, Test shot too. Punches a length ball on top of the bounce through cover. Fourth-stump line that was, rose around top of front pad
Overpitched on leg, clipped through square leg

Dropped by Rohit at first slip. Rickelton dove left and Rohit went right, ball was going real low. Was too far for the keeper, Rohit went with the right hand, ball hit the palm and popped to the right. Couldn't get it on the second attempt. Gorgeous ball nonetheless. Fullish on fourth, angling away, Rana tried to push it with a straight bat, got a thin outside edge.
Full on leg, clipped to midwicket. 134ks
Swings in to beat bat. Rana tried to help it along with a lofted flick over square leg, gets hit on pad. Ball was on the fuller side of length, just outside leg
Length on leg, clipped to deep square leg
Bouncer goes over the pull, keeper' gets a glove on it. Ball pops to the deep
A bit of swing in, on a back of length on off, tucked leg side
Fullish on middle, flicked to mid-on
Very short, rises around neck-height. Parag was hopping over the crease, didn't fend forward. Had hands close to the body, bottom hand came off, ball went off the sticker into the ground closeby
